comment: One cell per runner, qualification source and desktop OS (plan U8, R11/R12). A cell is passed only for what ran; replayed-capture, live capture-run and restore evidence are recorded separately. Receipts named here live in receipts/ and pass tool/check_evidence_receipts.dart. Blocked and not-run cells stay visible; a MangaFire cell that is not passed keeps M1 open (U8b: Paperback 0.9 passes on Windows; Tachi passes its operations but its browser path was not exercised live; macOS and Linux MangaFire cells stay open; no restore was made).

evidenceKinds.replayed: operations replayed from committed captures by the package test suites on this OS
evidenceKinds.live: a manual, rate-limited capture run against the site (U8b: Paperback 0.9 and Tachi MangaFire on Windows, 2026-11-21; none for the other sources)
evidenceKinds.restore: a generated backup restored in a clean destination app (separate lane; none recorded in U8)
